manifest.description: Mutating synthesis of a DTO or Java record plus matching jOOQ projection — creates a named projection type and rewrites a selected Records.mapping(...) or lambda mapping to use it, preserving field order, aliases, nested multiset result types, nullability-visible types, and imports. Supports local nested DTOs only when that matches surrounding code style; otherwise creates a package-level type.
when_to_use: java-jooq-projection-mapping-analysis identified a DTO candidate and the operator approves materializing it
a Records.mapping(...) site mixes generated record leakage with hand-built constructor args and should bind to a named DTO
hardening a UI/API-facing query so its projection mapping points at a named DTO instead of a generated record
anti_patterns: do not change field order, aliases, multiset nesting, nullability-visible types, or imports beyond what the new DTO requires
do not synthesize a local nested DTO when surrounding style is package-level (or vice versa) — follow the visible code style
do not invent fields not present in the selected projection — DTO shape mirrors the projection
do not change return types of unrelated callers; this atom only rewrites the selected mapping site
do not apply when status=blocked or when apply is not explicitly true

source.description: Java file containing the projection mapping to rewrite, relative to project_dir.

target.description: Path for the new DTO/Record .java file (package-level) — omit when style=local_nested.

style.description: Operator choice of DTO placement style. Must match surrounding code style.

mapping_site.description: Identifies the Records.mapping(...) / lambda mapping to rewrite — file/line/byte range or item_name + projection index.

validation_cmd.description: Validation command after apply. Defaults to ["mvn", "compile"].

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-jooq-synthesize-dto-projection. Charter: materialize a named DTO/record for a selected projection mapping and rewrite the mapping site, preserving order/aliases/nullability/nested-multiset shape.

Protocol:

1. Ground the target structurally:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")
   bbox_code_symbols(project_dir="{{project_dir}}", query="{{module_name}}", languages=["java"], item_kinds=["class_declaration", "record_declaration"])
   Confirm the mapping site resolves and the chosen DTO name does not collide.

2. Plan the synthesis — PREVIEW only:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_jooq_synthesize_dto_projection",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      target="{{target}}",
                      module_name="{{module_name}}",
                      toml_entries={"style": "{{style}}",
                                    "mapping_site": {{mapping_site}}})

   The planner refuses arity mismatches between the projection and the synthesized DTO, refuses placement style that conflicts with surrounding code style, and refuses to lose nested multiset typing.

3. Decide:
   - If status=blocked, emit bbox_note(kind="blocked") with block_reason and return.
   - If apply is not true, return status="planned".

4. Apply (only when inputs.apply == true):
   bbox_refactor_run(dispatch_origin="agent", confirm=true, steps=[
     <java_jooq_synthesize_dto_projection step from the plan>,
     {"op":"command","command":"<validation_cmd[0]>","args":<validation_cmd[1..]>,"required":true}
   ])
   Default validation_cmd is ["mvn", "compile"].

5. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line: DTO name, style, fields, mapping site rewritten, validation result>).

Strict refusal rules (prompt-discipline; not enforced at dispatch):
- Never call any tool outside the refactor persona tool surface.
- Never invent fields not present in the selected projection.
- Never change unrelated caller return types.
- Never override the operator's placement style.
- Never default apply=true on the operator's behalf.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{module_name}} {{style}} {{mapping_site}} {{apply}} {{validation_cmd}}
